title: Applying the fuzzy distinction method to analyze the precautionary area of the wind farm along the western coast of Taiwan
core_idea: Proposes a precautionary-area planning model for offshore wind farms on Taiwan's western coast that integrates automatic identification system (AIS) ship-navigation data, marine geographic information system (MGIS) spatial analysis, and fuzzy logic control (FLC) to account for navigational safety, ecological sensitivity, and wind/hydrological factors.
tldr: Proposes integrating AIS, MGIS, and fuzzy logic control to create a precautionary-area planning model for western Taiwan offshore wind farms that balances navigation, ecological, and environmental factors.
